metadata.comparison_protocol: One fixed Euclidean dataset per size; GA and Random Search have independent recorded seeds and matched complete-tour evaluation budgets per repeat. Deterministic methods run once. Runtime is measured wall-clock time and depends on hardware, scheduling, and implementation. 2-opt evaluations count candidate tours; Held–Karp counts dynamic-programming transitions and is not an equal-budget comparison.
metadata.distance_units: Euclidean coordinate units, not road distance
metadata.std_definition: Sample SD (ddof=1); zero for deterministic single runs; undefined for stochastic single runs
